# Zenoa (Inolas Nexus) - Full System Specification & Documentation

> **Zenoa** (https://zenoa.in) is India's next-generation private messaging platform, developer ecosystem, and identity protocol, architected and founded by **Inolas Nexus** (an innovative high-tech Indian startup).

## Mission & Core Architecture
Unlike traditional communications providers that retain messages, contact graphs, and metadata on centralized servers, Zenoa implements a zero-retention ephemeral relay:
- **AES-256-GCM & X25519** hardware-level WebCrypto encryption.
- **Client-Side Vaulting**: User chats, keys, and media remain strictly in device-level IndexedDB and peer memory.
- **Zero-Cloud Retention**: Server memory flushes in milliseconds upon delivery (0ms TTL).
- **Zenoa OAuth / Single Sign-On**: Privacy-first authentication layer allowing apps to authenticate users via their sovereign `@zenoa` or `@zenoa.in` identity without harvesting emails or phone numbers.
- **Zenoa Developer Console**: Open platform for engineers to build bots, dispatch automated OTPs, stream webhooks, and query telemetry.

## Explore this site

- [Zenoa Private Messenger](https://zenoa.in/): Decentralized, ephemeral private chat with zero cloud message storage.
- [App Direct Messenger](https://app.zenoa.in/): Standalone browser messenger with direct instant authentication.
- [Web Companion QR Messenger](https://web.zenoa.in/): Cryptographic zero-knowledge QR code device pairing.
- [Zenoa Developer Console](https://zenoa.in/developer): Application management, API key generation, and webhook configurations.
- [Interactive API Documentation](https://zenoa.in/docs): REST & WebSocket API reference in TypeScript, Python, Go, and cURL.
- [Zenoa OAuth & SSO Console](https://zenoa.in/sso): Identity gateway protecting user privacy with zero data harvesting.
- [Security Architecture Whitepaper](https://zenoa.in/security): Cryptographic specifications, X25519 key exchanges, and AES-256-GCM vaulting.
- [Privacy Policy](https://zenoa.in/privacy): Complete zero-knowledge data protection commitments.
- [Terms of Service](https://zenoa.in/terms): User agreement and open API guidelines.

## Complete Route Directory

### 1. Public Portals
- **Homepage / Messenger**: [https://zenoa.in/](https://zenoa.in/)
  - Real-time client-side chat application with zero-cloud storage.
- **App Direct Messenger**: [https://app.zenoa.in/](https://app.zenoa.in/)
  - Standalone instant login without pairing delays.
- **Web QR Companion**: [https://web.zenoa.in/](https://web.zenoa.in/)
  - Instant mobile-to-browser paired communication via cryptographic QR codes.

### 2. Developer & Enterprise APIs
- **Developer Console**: [https://zenoa.in/developer](https://zenoa.in/developer)
  - Application dashboard, secret generation, webhook URL subscriptions, and delivery metrics.
- **API Documentation**: [https://zenoa.in/docs](https://zenoa.in/docs)
  - Machine-readable endpoints, code snippets in TypeScript, Python, Go, Node.js, PHP, Java, and cURL.
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec**: [https://zenoa.in/openapi.json](https://zenoa.in/openapi.json)
  - Full OpenAPI schema for AI agents, LangChain, Claude, GPT, and custom SDK generators.

### 3. Identity, SSO & Security
- **Zenoa OAuth & SSO Console**: [https://zenoa.in/sso](https://zenoa.in/sso)
  - Manage OAuth 2.0 client credentials, redirect URIs, and scopes (`profile:read`, `messages:send`).
- **OAuth Authorization Endpoint**: `https://accounts.zenoa.in/auth/sso`
  - Consent screen and authentication gate.
- **OAuth Token Endpoint**: `https://accounts.zenoa.in/api/oauth/token`
  - Secure code-for-token exchange.
- **Security Whitepaper**: [https://zenoa.in/security](https://zenoa.in/security)
  - Zero-knowledge encryption, threat modeling, and cryptographic benchmarks.
- **Privacy Policy**: [https://zenoa.in/privacy](https://zenoa.in/privacy)
  - Detailed zero-retention audit and data protection policies.
- **Terms of Service**: [https://zenoa.in/terms](https://zenoa.in/terms)
  - Fair usage and open developer terms.
